ArgonTest.Name: Method overrides nothing
ArgonTest.InputSource:
module _
import Argon.Core::*
trait MyTrait public virtual proc _.say_hello(): () = puts "Hello World" end
instance MyInst: MyTrait public override proc _.say_hello2(): () = puts "Hello World2" end
proc main(): () do let o = MyInst
o.say_hello() end
